subject: Vendor portal onboarding & evidence intake for GreenTree Logistics
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@gtlogistics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@gtlogistics.com
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding: Vendr + SOC 2 questionnaire

Hi Jonas,

We're starting vendor security intake for GreenTree and need to onboard Redwood into our Vendr profile so we can collect SOC 2 evidence and a CAIQ pass. Attached is the initial questionnaire with the sections our procurement/security teams flagged as high priority (SOC, KMS, logging).

Can you confirm the best technical contact to receive a Vendr invite and where you prefer to upload artifacts (Vendr profile vs. OneTrust S3)? We typically ask for a named contact, an SSO admin email, and a preferred retention window for logs.

Attachments: GT_Questionnaire_init.xlsx (spreadsheet - sections + sample answers)

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Security Program Manager
GreenTree Logistics
lydia.park@gtlogistics.com

--
Note: we'll need signed evidence of SOC 2 scope before procurement can move to PO.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@gtlogistics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: Vendr + SOC 2 questionnaire

Hi Lydia — thanks for the packet.

Short answer: we can do Vendr as the primary intake and also mirror evidence to an internal S3 for longer-term retention if needed. My suggestions:
- Technical contact: laura.bennett@redwood.ai (sec intake lead)
- SSO admin: ben.carter@redwood.ai
- Default retention for portal uploads: 24 months (we can adjust by artifact class)

Laura/Ben — looping you both in to accept the Vendr invite and coordinate the first evidence push. Laura, if you can confirm the list of critical docs (SOC 2 report, control narratives, KMS rotation, syslog samples) I'll schedule a short upload window.

If you prefer a DocuSign route for PO/MSA signatures before evidence exchange, we can accept that too — happy to take the DocuSign link.

Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Thanks Ben — I see the Vendr profile and the invite. We'll do the first push during the scheduled window. A couple of notes from procurement/security review after scanning your initial uploads:
- CAIQ section 3.2 (data classification mapping) is missing a brief control narrative. Can you add a one-paragraph mapping to how Redwood tags and handles PII/PCI/PHI?
- Please include a signed evidence item for KMS rotation (audit entry or rotation policy with timestamp).

I've attached a small gap snapshot that our team generated from the questionnaire (CAIQ-gap-snapshot.pdf). If you can add the two items above before EOD Monday, procurement can proceed with PO issuance and the DocuSign PO link below.

DocuSign PO: https://www.docusign.com/po/ABC-7890

Looking forward to the kickoff.
